messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary metrics alert for customer Tempest (pool: tempest-prod-pool) — 5xx spike 11.7% over 3m (threshold 5%). Canary paused automatically. Alert: https://console.redwood/alerts/INC-22876
maria: i'm oncall SRE — taking this. tagging ML oncall: @oncall-ml can you triage model/runtime side?
incident-bot: Paging @oncall-ml for incident INC-22876-Tempest-canary — severity S2
oncall-ml: oncall-ml here. quick ask: what customer-visible failures are we seeing? kelly-cs any details from Tempest support?
kelly-cs: Tempest support: intermittent failures on inferences and 5-10s latencies for interactive endpoints. They report ~7 job failures in last 20m. public status: https://support.tempest/status
ops-lead: digging into worker logs for tempest-prod-pool — lots of model load fails and OOM traces around 22:40 UTC. snippet:
```
E 2026-09-08T22:40:12Z loader.go:271 kernel:init failed: quant_layout_mismatch
panic: runtime: out of memory
```
sachin: that points at an artifact/runtime mismatch — looks like the new pinned artifact introduced a quant layout our runtime doesn't handle. recommend immediate traffic eviction and pin back to prior artifact.
maria: agreed. ops, can you move Tempest to fallback routing so other customers are safe?
ops-lead: doing traffic isolation now — moving customer to shared-fallback and removing canary target. Commands run:
```
redwoodctl route update --customer tempest --to shared-fallback --note "isolate after canary anomaly"
redwoodctl canary pause --id canary-22876-tempest
```
deploy-bot: route update accepted, canary paused.
sachin: i'll pin the pool runtime to the previous stable image used by Tempest: `inference-runtime:2026-07-14-stable`. Running:
```
redwoodctl service pin --customer tempest --pool tempest-prod-pool --artifact inference-runtime:2026-07-14-stable --reason "revert canary artifact"
redwoodctl rollout cancel --canary canary-22876-tempest
```
ops-lead: pin applied and canary rollout cancelled. next: flush KV/kv-cache and restart workers in the pool to clear any persisted quant layouts.
oncall-ml: kv/cache flush is important — quant metadata is sometimes persisted.
```
redwoodctl cache flush --customer tempest --scope kv --confirm
orchestratorctl restart --pool tempest-prod-pool --grace 45s
```
maria: triggering smoke checks now. sachin, can you run the quick probe and paste results?
sachin: smoke probe run:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"smoke-check"}' https://api.redwood/tempest/v1/generate | jq .status
# got: "ok"; latency 140ms; 0 5xx in probe
```
kelly-cs: just informed Tempest: "We routed your traffic to a safe fallback pool and reverted the runtime image to the prior stable build. Engineers are validating; we'll update in 20m." They replied: "Thanks — please advise when we can resume normal routing."
incident-bot: Incident INC-22876-Tempest created — severity S2 — assignees: maria, oncall-ml, ops-lead
oncall-ml: quick summary for handoff: rolled back runtime artifact to inference-runtime:2026-07-14-stable; flushed KV cache; evicted traffic to shared-fallback; paused and cancelled canary. Likely root cause: new artifact incompatible with deployed quant kernels. No evidence of data leakage. Customer-visible window ~22:30-22:45 UTC with ~7 failed jobs. Mitigation applied and metrics improving (5xx <0.5% last 10m).
maria: i'm handing off monitoring to night SRE @sachin at 23:00 UTC. Handoff checklist in this thread:
- watch 30m stable window for customer 5xx <1%
- keep Tempest on shared-fallback until sign-off from ENG-ML and CS
- if failures recur, escalate to ENG-ML and open emergency revert for similar pools
- update Tempest CS every 20 minutes
sachin: ack — i'll own monitoring and customer comms overnight until 06:00 UTC. will post any anomalies here. :eyes:
ops-lead: aggregated logs and core dumps uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-22876/ (worker logs, model-loader traces).
kelly-cs: Tempest asked when normal routing will resume — noting we'll only restore after 30m stable window and postmortem signoff.
oncall-ml: note to infra/ci: add a canary quantization verification step for dedicated/VPC pool builds to catch quant layout regressions before rollout.
maria: closing active mitigation now. converting incident to follow-up task(s) in infra backlog for root cause analysis and CI improvements. :white_check_mark:
sachin: ongoing monitoring; will send final closure update if stable at 06:00 UTC. last message id 2287607621
